title: my rural town (it’s kind of adorable)
en: good morning everyone it is a lovely cool day and I'm off to town to run some errands most important of which is to find a new book to read which is an absolute emergency I go into town regularly since I frequent the post office things get busy during tourist season so I tend to get up very early in the morning and avoid the crowds however comparatively few people live here full-time I'm grateful for this since it is very important to me to be involved in my community even if it's a small one I found that as someone who prefers more quiet living it gives me great joy to spend time in town and then be able to go home to a more peaceful Haven when I feel like it I did this in the city too

and prioritized having a peaceful space to go home to after work this town is right next to a river so it is wonderful to be able to walk around on a hot day and then go down to the water to cool off and read as with many beautiful places this area struggles with having many vacation homes that are empty most of the year so it can be difficult to find places to rent thankfully there are many young people who've gotten creative and found ways to live and work here full-time sometimes living off grid or fixing up

old houses it's definitely useful to be handy here as help can be in short supply my boyfriend used to work in construction and is now a surveyor and I've enjoyed the benefits of his carpentry skills and experience with home repairs many times of course my favorite place in my town is my bookstore it always brings me back to my time as a book seller there's so much magic in places like these I always think about the way the shells are just full of stories waiting to be discovered I've recently been reading a lot of fantasy and fairy tales I love to get lost in here for hours if there is only one piece of

advice I would ever give someone trying to find a new place to live is to be very patient in my experience is that with an open heart the right home has a way of finding you if only you slowly work towards your goals and let life guide you to the right place at the right time of course if moving to a new location isn't practical which is understandable I truly believe that an abundant and peaceful home life can only be created not found for example my mother researched homes throughout the decades my father was in the military it took her nearly 30 years she wanted to find an affordable place with in her budget and at long last she found her dream home she couldn't be happier saying that the adventure that brought her here made her far more ready and grateful for it I've

taken inspiration from her and know someday I will have my own home and will enjoy waiting for it as I put aside a little bit every month anyway I hope you all have a lovely day next week I will share with you the only other part of my town that I love almost as much as the bookstore so I will see you soon it's
zh: 大家早上好，这是一个凉爽的一天，我要去城里办一些事，其中最重要的是找一本新书读，这绝对是紧急情况。我定期进城，因为我经常去邮局，在旅游旺季，事情很忙，所以我倾向于早上起得很早，避开人群，但全职住在这里的人相对较少，我对此很感激，因为参与我的社区对我来说非常重要，即使它是一个小社区，我发现作为一个喜欢更安静的生活，在城里度过时光给我带来很大的快乐，然后当我想的时候能够回家到一个更安静的避风港，我在城里也这样做过
优先考虑下班后有一个安静的空间回家，这个小镇就在河边，所以能够在炎热的天气里四处走走，然后到水里凉快一下，读书真是太棒了，因为这个地区有许多美丽的地方，有许多度假屋一年中大部分时间都是空的，所以很难找到出租的地方，值得庆幸的是，有很多年轻人发挥了创造力，找到了在这里全职生活和工作的方法，有时生活在电网之外或修理
老房子，在这里方便，因为帮助可能短缺，我的男朋友曾经在建筑业工作，现在是一名测量员，我多次享受到他的木工技能和房屋维修经验的好处，当然，我在镇上最喜欢的地方是我的书店，它总是让我回到我作为一名书商的时代，像这样的地方有如此多的魔力，我总是在想，贝壳里充满了等待被发现的故事，我最近读了很多幻想和童话如果只有一个故事，我喜欢在这里迷失几个小时

根据我的经验，我给那些试图寻找新住处的人的建议是要非常耐心，只要你慢慢地朝着你的目标努力，让生活在正确的时间引导你到正确的地方，正确的家就会找到你，当然，如果搬到一个新的地方不切实际，这是可以理解的，我坚信，丰富而和平的家庭生活只能被创造，而不是被发现，例如，我母亲在我父亲在军队的几十年里研究了房屋，她花了近30年的时间才想在她的预算范围内找到一个负担得起的地方，最后她找到了她梦想的家，她高兴极了，说把她带到这里的冒险让她更加准备好并对此表示感激。
从她那里得到了灵感，我知道有一天我会拥有自己的家，并且会享受等待它的过程，因为我每个月都会留出一点钱，无论如何，我希望你们下周都度过愉快的一天，我将与你们分享我镇上唯一的其他部分，我几乎和书店一样喜欢，所以我很快就会见到你们了
